title: Tahini Yogurt Sauce
description: Yogurt and tahini whisked with garlic into a tangy sauce.

ingredients.item: plain yogurt, milk kefir or vegan yogurt
garlic cloves, finely minced (or 1/2 tsp granulated)

items.item: Aleppo chile flakes or Urfa biber

uses: garlic cloves, finely minced (or 1/2 tsp granulated)

steps.do: Whisk the yogurt, tahini, garlic, salt and pepper in a medium bowl until completely smooth.
uses: plain yogurt, milk kefir or vegan yogurt
garlic cloves, finely minced (or 1/2 tsp granulated)

steps.do: Taste. Add the lemon juice only if your yogurt isn't tangy, since some are sharper than others. With fat-free yogurt, add the olive oil or a little extra tahini for richness. Adjust salt and pepper.
Refrigerate until serving, then top with herbs and chile flakes if you like.
uses: Aleppo chile flakes or Urfa biber

notes: Keeps 4 days in an airtight container in the fridge, longer if made with granulated garlic instead of fresh.
Use with Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma, falafel, lamb, or as a bed for roasted cauliflower and other vegetables. Also good as a dip with pita.
A pinch of lemon zest is a nice garnish; in winter, pomegranate seeds.
